before: The navigation pane scrolls away inside the viewport, ignores Ctrl+F, keeps focus where it was, and shifts the page off narrow screens.
after: The navigation pane stays on the scrollport, opens Find on Ctrl+F or Cmd+F, moves focus in and out, overlays narrow viewports, and measures the widest page.
reason: Only adapter chrome changes. The pane reads the outline, search, and page geometry, and moves the local selection through existing calls. No shared field, operation, snapshot, or protocol message changes.
